mission.title: Sharing the authentic Benin
mission.text: Bénin Tourisme was born from a deep passion for this extraordinary country. Our mission is to build bridges between curious travelers and local communities, to reveal Benin's cultural and natural richness, and to contribute to sustainable tourism that benefits everyone.

members.bio: Passionate about Benin for 20 years, founded Bénin Tourisme to share the treasures of his home country.
An expert in sustainable tourism, Sophie makes sure every trip has a positive impact.
A historian by training, Marc knows every corner of Benin.
An anthropologist, Amina creates immersive experiences.
David makes sure every detail of your trip is perfect.
Always available, Grace is your go-to contact.
